verdict.rationale: Linear's Loops are documented as recurring agent workflows. Users describe a job in plain language and choose to run it on a schedule or in response to events (linear-docs-36, linear-docs-11, linear-docs-95). Concrete examples include updating launch plans and posting to Slack (linear-docs-100, linear-docs-12). Missing for 10: detail on schedule configuration such as cron granularity, run history, and failure handling; independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled loops work as claimed.
